draft.emotion: a neutral, objective tone used to describe someone in a factual way
notes: Grammatically feminine regardless of the person's actual gender, so adjectives and verbs agreeing with it take feminine forms (e.g., 'ta młoda osoba przyszła').
Notice the vowel change in the genitive plural: 'osób' (e.g., 'pięć osób' — five people).
